title: Slotwise Parseval: Σ_{all I} φ(u_I)² is the same for every orthonormal basis u (parent Step 2)
statement: For all P, k ∈ ℕ, any two orthonormal bases u = (u_0,…,u_{P−1}) and v = (v_0,…,v_{P−1}) of ℝ^P (OrthonormalBasis (Fin P) ℝ (Eucl P)) and every k-covector φ on ℝ^P (Covector (Eucl P) k): Σ_{I : {0,…,k−1} → [P]} φ(u_{I(0)},…,u_{I(k−1)})² = Σ_{I : {0,…,k−1} → [P]} φ(v_{I(0)},…,v_{I(k−1)})². Both sums run over all index maps I : Fin k → Fin P.
lean_statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (u v : OrthonormalBasis (Fin P) ℝ (Eucl P)) (φ : Covector (Eucl P) k), ∑ I : Fin k → Fin P, (φ (fun i => u (I i))) ^ 2 = ∑ I : Fin k → Fin P, (φ (fun i => v (I i))) ^ 2
